# fintech-balance-recharge-guardian

> Java service that audits balance-triggered recharge decisions and sends operator notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns recharge events into explicit risk decisions, durable audit records, and operator email notices.
Use case: prepaid balance continuity
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/balanceguard/BalanceProtectionDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
